title: Attia A. Nasreddin, born on April 24, 1950, in Asmara, Eritrea, has had a distinguished career in Nigeria since 1976, starting as General Manager of Nasco Foods and eventually becoming the Chairman/CEO of Nasco Group of Companies. He is recognized for his significant contributions to employment creation, community development, and social responsibility, including support for education, healthcare, and infrastructure. His leadership has earned him numerous national and international awards, reflecting his commitment to the Nigerian economy and society. Mr. Nasreddin is known for his integrity, intelligence, and dedication to improving the quality of life for Nigerians, and he remains focused on furthering economic development in the country.
